niya: quick bring-up note: tested hermes-40b-8bit with speculative prefetch lookahead=5 on staging.

sam: perf?

niya: median token latency down ~20% (250->200ms), p95 +5ms, token cost ~-22%.

oliver: quality signal?

niya: small early-repeat on QA prompts and a couple truncated code blocks. saw 'kv-sync-gap' in logs when fallback happened.

ops-bot: deploy complete: shard staging-3 hermes-40b-8bit-spec. logs: /ops/logs/3241590000 (grep kv-sync-gap).

sam: quick hypothesis: 8-bit quant smooths attention tails, prefetch picks wrong branch, fallback ends up reusing stale KV.

oliver: mitigation options: reduce lookahead to 3-4, enable kv-validate (checks cache coherence), or apply small temperature bump to attention.

niya: ran small AB on commons-qa (200 ex): lookahead=4 vs lookahead=5+kv-validate. results: L4 repeat-rate 0.9%, median +6ms; L5+kv repeat-rate 0.2%, median +11ms; ppl deltas minimal (+0.1).

sam: seems kv-validate best for quality but costy. recommendation: default lookahead=4 for hermes-40b-8bit, kv-validate opt-in for sensitive routes (code/qa). canary 5% Dedicated with these settings and monitor repeat-rate and p95 for 24h.

oliver: will add repeat-rate and truncation metrics to the model dashboard and set an alert at repeat-rate > 1%.

niya: filing short ops note with sample diffs and logs, tagging @eng-oncall. next experiment: try attention fp16 + rest quant to see if we can raise lookahead safely.

(thumbsup)
